scope: 仅核查碳离子深度剂量数值；不复做NIST质子阻止本领查询，不扩展其他条目

claim.originalText: Bragg峰：带电粒子接近射程末端时单位路径能量沉积显著增加，峰后剂量快速下降；这是与光子深度剂量分布的重要区别。
claim.directSupport: IAEA TRS 398 Figure 16 给出水中单能290 MeV/u碳束相对深度剂量曲线；可见约160 mm处的窄Bragg峰及峰后非零尾部。
remaining: 原图只有曲线而非机器可读数值表；本记录点值为人工按坐标轴目测数字化估计，不是IAEA原始表列值。
本数据只对应该图的单能碳束/水条件，不能外推为所有离子能量、材料或临床计划的固定峰深/尾部百分比。
该图是单能Bragg峰，不是SOBP；不能与TRS 461 Figure 1.2的生物等效剂量曲线混作同一数据集。
claim.minimumRevision: 将一般性表述限定为特定条件下的质子/离子深度剂量特征；重离子碎裂可形成峰后非零尾部；电子束另行说明。

source.title: Absorbed Dose Determination in External Beam Radiotherapy: An International Code of Practice for Dosimetry Based on Standards of Absorbed Dose to Water
source.caption: Depth dose distribution of a monoenergetic 290 MeV/u carbon beam in water.

axes.x: Depth in water (mm), plotted from 0 to 180 mm
axes.y: Relative dose, plotted from 0 to 100; the plotted peak is 100

source.actuallyInspected: Official PDF page image was opened and visually inspected in this turn; adjacent text states the distal tail is due to fragmentation of incident particles.
source.dataAvailability: No machine-readable point table or raw data array found in the report; values below are visual digitization estimates from the printed graph.

conditions.observable: relative depth dose, not absolute absorbed dose in Gy and not RBE-weighted/biological dose
conditions.beamFieldAndDetectorDetails: not specified by Figure 16 itself; not inferred here

digitization.method: Manual visual reading against the published figure axes and grid; relative-dose values rounded to whole percentage points.
digitization.status: approximate graph-derived estimates, not original tabulated measurements
digitization.precisionLimit: No formal pixel digitizer, uncertainty propagation, or independent second-reader check was performed. Near the sharp distal fall-off, small depth-reading differences cause large relative-dose differences.

boundaries.localDraftAvailability: B/C/D drafts mentioned in v13 receipt were not found in the connected Library or on the remote branch; this record continues from the v12 remote evidence boundary and the official source figure.
